@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
+# Attitude Determination Subsystem — Multiplicative Extended Kalman Filter
+# DRM 1 | Requirements: ADS-FLT-001 through ADS-FLT-003
+#
+# State: [δθ (3, attitude error), δb (3, gyro bias error)] = 6 states
+# Nominal: q_est (quaternion), gyro_bias (3-vec)
+
+using LinearAlgebra
+
+mutable struct ADSMEKFState
+    q_est::Vector{Float64}       # estimated quaternion [w,x,y,z]
+    gyro_bias::Vector{Float64}   # estimated gyro bias (rad/s)
+    P::Matrix{Float64}           # 6×6 error covariance
+end
+
+function ads_mekf_init(;
+    q0::AbstractVector = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
+    bias0::AbstractVector = zeros(3),
+    P0::AbstractMatrix = 1e-4 * Matrix{Float64}(I, 6, 6))
+    ADSMEKFState(normalize(q0), collect(Float64, bias0), collect(Float64, P0))
+end
+
+# ── Predict ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+"""
+    ads_mekf_predict!(state, omega_meas, dt, Q)
+
+Propagate MEKF using gyro measurement. ADS-FLT-001.
+"""
+function ads_mekf_predict!(state::ADSMEKFState,
+                            omega_meas::AbstractVector,
+                            dt::Float64,
+                            Q::AbstractMatrix)
+    ω = omega_meas .- state.gyro_bias
+
+    # Propagate quaternion (axis-angle integration)
+    θ = norm(ω) * dt
+    if θ > 1e-12
+        axis = ω ./ norm(ω)
+        δq = [cos(θ/2); axis .* sin(θ/2)]
+        state.q_est = normalize(quat_multiply(state.q_est, δq))
+    end
+
+    # Linearized state transition (F is 6×6)
+    Ω = skew(ω)
+    F = [Matrix{Float64}(I,3,3) - Ω*dt    -dt*Matrix{Float64}(I,3,3);
+         zeros(3,3)              Matrix{Float64}(I,3,3)]
+
+    state.P = F * state.P * F' + Q
+end
+
+# ── Update: star tracker ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+"""
+    ads_mekf_update_star_tracker!(state, q_meas, R_st)
+
+ADS-FLT-002: quaternion measurement update.
+"""
+function ads_mekf_update_star_tracker!(state::ADSMEKFState,
+                                        q_meas::AbstractVector,
+                                        R_st::AbstractMatrix)
+    # Attitude error innovation (MRP approximation for small angles)
+    q_est_inv = [state.q_est[1]; -state.q_est[2:4]]
+    δq = quat_multiply(q_est_inv, q_meas)
+    sign_w = δq[1] >= 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0
+    z = 2.0 * sign_w * δq[2:4]
+
+    # H = [I₃ | 0] — attitude block only
+    H = [Matrix{Float64}(I,3,3)  zeros(3,3)]
+    _kf_update!(state, z, H, R_st)
+end
+
+# ── Update: vector measurement ────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+"""
+    ads_mekf_update_vector!(state, b_meas, b_ref_I, R_vec)
+
+ADS-FLT-002: unit-vector measurement (magnetometer or sun sensor).
+"""
+function ads_mekf_update_vector!(state::ADSMEKFState,
+                                  b_meas::AbstractVector,
+                                  b_ref_I::AbstractVector,
+                                  R_vec::AbstractMatrix)
+    b_pred = quat_rotate(state.q_est, normalize(b_ref_I))
+    z = b_meas .- b_pred
+    H = [-skew(b_pred)  zeros(3,3)]
+    _kf_update!(state, z, H, R_vec)
+end
+
+# ── Internal KF update ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function _kf_update!(state::ADSMEKFState,
+                     z::AbstractVector,
+                     H::AbstractMatrix,
+                     R::AbstractMatrix)
+    S = H * state.P * H' + R
+    K = state.P * H' * (S \\ Matrix{Float64}(I, size(S)...))
+
+    δx = K * z
+
+    # Apply attitude correction
+    δφ = δx[1:3]
+    angle = norm(δφ)
+    if angle > 1e-12
+        δq = quat_from_axis_angle(δφ ./ angle, angle)
+        state.q_est = normalize(quat_multiply(state.q_est, δq))
+    end
+
+    # Apply bias correction
+    state.gyro_bias .+= δx[4:6]
+
+    # Joseph-form covariance update (numerical stability)
+    I6 = Matrix{Float64}(I, 6, 6)
+    IKH = I6 - K * H
+    state.P = IKH * state.P * IKH' + K * R * K'
+end
+
+# ── Diagnostics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+"""NEES = χ²(3): normalized estimation error squared on attitude."""
+function compute_nees(state::ADSMEKFState, q_true::AbstractVector)
+    q_inv = [state.q_est[1]; -state.q_est[2:4]]
+    δq = quat_multiply(q_inv, q_true)
+    sign_w = δq[1] >= 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0
+    err = 2.0 * sign_w * δq[2:4]
+    P_att = state.P[1:3, 1:3]
+    err' * (P_att \\ err)
+end
+
+"""Attitude error in degrees between estimate and truth."""
+attitude_error_deg(s::ADSMEKFState, q_true::AbstractVector) =
+    quat_angle_deg(s.q_est, q_true)
+
+# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function skew(v::AbstractVector)
+    [ 0.0   -v[3]   v[2];
+      v[3]   0.0   -v[1];
+     -v[2]   v[1]   0.0]
+end
+
